## Theme Submission

### Theme Details
- **Theme Name**: <!-- e.g. cyber-neon -->
- **Contributor**: @<!-- your github username -->
- **Location**: `themes/<username>/<theme-name>.toml`

### Checklist
- [ ] Theme configuration is valid TOML.
- [ ] Theme file is placed in `themes/<github-username>/<theme-name>.toml`.
- [ ] Theme name uses lowercase `kebab-case` (3-30 chars).
- [ ] No personal tokens, API keys, or private paths are contained in the config.
- [ ] Tested with current Starship version.
